evals.name: stress-test-prd-before-leadership
evals.prompt: I'm sending this PRD to leadership tomorrow morning asking them to approve a $200K Q3 budget. Can you stress test it from multiple angles before I hit send? Objectives are in OBJECTIVES.md next to the doc. Doc: evals/fixtures/integrations-budget-prd.md
evals.expected_output: Panel-review skill triggers. A {doc}.panel/ folder is created next to the PRD with README.md, personas/ (skeptic + target-reader + domain-expert + at least one objective-derived persona like cfo or ceo), and round-01/ containing index.md (with sha256), source.md (frozen copy), reviews/{persona}/findings/*.md, findings/*.md (consolidated, 1-3 sentence canonical bodies, sources point to review findings), consolidation.md (short index), human.md (empty annotation scaffold). Output is findings, not edits to the PRD.

evals.name: explicit-slash-command-invocation
evals.expected_output: Same end-to-end outcome as eval 1: full round-01 produced. The explicit slash command invocation should NOT cause the skill to skip the persona-setup pause or the round-confirmation pause — these are load-bearing.

evals.name: continuation-appends-round-02
evals.prompt: I addressed the round-01 findings on the integrations PRD and revised the doc. Can you run another round of panel review on the updated version? The panel folder already exists from last time.
evals.expected_output: Skill detects the existing {doc}.panel/ folder, asks once whether to continue, and on confirmation appends a round-02/ without re-creating personas or README. round-02 contains its own index.md (new sha256 since the doc changed), source.md (new frozen copy of revised doc), reviews/{persona}/findings/*.md, findings/*.md, consolidation.md, human.md. round-01 is untouched. Same panel personas are used unless the user requests changes.
